scope: This artifact is a parsing Skill, not a reproduction of one paper. The deviations below are measured between the skill's output and the source documents it was run on, which is the only reference truth that exists for a layout task.
empirical_envelope: Two-column and single-column English journal/conference layouts with an embedded text layer (poppler-decodable).
Tested range: 2-15 pages, body font 15-19 pt, 0-3 gutters per page, 0-6 tables, 0-6 numbered equations per document.
Runtime 0.6-1.7 s per document on one core; no model calls, no network.

deviations_from_paper.note: arXiv:1512.03385; the final entry has no [n] marker and is not split out
ResNet Fig. 3 caption loses a mid-caption fragment split by a wide space
dense borderless 10 pt grid merges two adjacent columns
4 sections, 1 table grid, 1 numbered equation, 3 references recovered verbatim

failure_modes.mode: Dense borderless table with <2 em column gaps
failure_modes.impact: adjacent columns merge in the markdown grid; caption and data rows survive

failure_modes.mode: Caption fragment separated by a wide space and sharing the figure baseline
failure_modes.impact: a few caption words are dropped (6 of 25 in ResNet Fig. 3)

failure_modes.mode: PDF whose fonts carry no ToUnicode mapping (private-use / CID codes)
failure_modes.impact: text is unreadable by any extractor; the skill returns cannot_judge instead of emitting glyph ids

failure_modes.mode: Scanned page with no text layer

failure_modes.impact: emitted as concatenated glyphs (Wi, not W_i); verbatim fidelity is preferred over semantic rewriting
